description: Advanced Messaging Concept Development: Probe Data Control Message is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "Advanced Messaging Concept Development Team. (2016). Advanced Messaging Concept Development: Probe Data Control Message. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504504". Contains all PDCMs generated during the AMCD field testing program. The PDCM is a control message sent from the server to OBUs to customize a request for Probe Vehicle Data (PVD) from the receiving OBU. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 26 columns, among them Transmit Interval, Test No., SendAll, Send on More Then Value, Vehicle Status Device Type Tag, Snapshot Distance D2. The portal shows 2017-11-14 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recom. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
